jobs.name: 杏风 · 流云轻弓
jobs.design: A cheerful nimble archer's LIGHT WARM APRICOT-WOOD CLOUD BOW: graceful rounded shallow double-S recurve limbs with a slightly compact playful silhouette, honey/apricot golden laminated wood and sage-green inner edge. Each limb root has ONE broad rounded cloud-hook carved profile integrated flush into wood, no dangling pieces, no little jewel mosaic. Warm ivory horn tip caps, soft sage cloth-wrapped central grip with one small simple cloth knot on OUTSIDE of grip clear of fingers/string. SINGLE straight dark bowstring. Full straight arrow of warm light wood with a small smooth silver LEAF point, APRICOT-and-IVORY short rounded feather fletching, sage wrap and visible rear nock. Matching apricot/cream quiver arrow feathers and one simple round cloud stamp on the existing quiver; do not add extra arrows. Curving rounded lively design, not hard angular war bow.

jobs.name: 燕羽 · 燕翎风弓
jobs.design: A cool graceful SWALLOW-WING WIND BOW: lean elegant INK-TEAL laminated wooden bow with two broad sweeping JADE feather-shaped outer limb faces, each a SINGLE integrated tapering plane (not many feathers), slim muted bronze line at central joint, pale sage small tip caps. Continuous silhouette like a swallow's wing arc with slightly upswept beak-like solid tips; NO branches/forks, no extra wings, no fantasy protrusions interrupting bowstring. Dark central leather grip. SINGLE taut straight dark string. Arrow straight dark shaft, narrow silver-green long LEAF arrowhead, SAGE and INK-BLUE feather fletching shaped like small swallow tail feathers with clear rear nock. Quiver's three arrows match these feathers, one broad jade feather badge on existing quiver. Visual rhythm fluid, narrow and sweeping, obvious teal/green rather than ordinary brown bow.

jobs.name: 竹锋 · 劲竹战弓
jobs.design: A decisive strong huntress's BAMBOO WAR BOW: solid functional relatively robust curved laminated bamboo limbs, BAMBOO GREEN outer surface with pale golden inner wood strip. More STRAIGHT firm limb sections transitioning into angular but continuous recurved ends, distinct geometric profile rather than soft round bow; two or three broad bamboo-node bands across limbs, dark bronze plain reinforced tip caps and grip collars, wrapped dark brown sturdy short central handle. No sharp spikes, no gems or repeating diamond decorations. SINGLE straight taut bowstring joins tips. Arrow straight dark-bamboo shaft with a single short broad steel DIAMOND/leaf arrowhead, tightly shaped CHARCOAL and BAMBOO GREEN angular feather fletching, clear nock. Existing quiver becomes simple dark-brown leather with one angular bamboo-leaf stamp and matching three arrow feathers. Strong graphic nodes and angular blocks express confident strength; not merely recolor of existing generic bow.

jobs.name: 月竹 · 素月弧弓
jobs.design: A calm scholarly archer's MOON-CRESCENT BOW: slender clean continuous IVORY/PALE BAMBOO composite limbs with a fine deep-teal inner edge, forming an elegant smooth elongated crescent with modest recurves and very spare ornament. A single small smooth JADE crescent inset at limb root and two restrained aged-bronze collars, pale gray-green woven central handle. No bamboo-node segmentation, no feathers/wings/cloud ornaments or dangling pendants. Single perfectly straight dark string between tips. Arrow straight pale bamboo shaft, a narrow simple SILVER triangular leaf point, small IVORY-and-TEAL neat feather fletching with plain rear nock. Existing quiver pale bamboo/teal cloth-faced with ONE simple bamboo silhouette and three matching arrow feathers. Quiet restrained long curves and pale large value mass distinguish from other themes, not generic brown wood bow.
